    Subpieces #

    For finite sets T ⊆ S of points of the cover, the quiver of T embeds into that of S (incH), compatibly with composites in the cover (compD_map). A representation of the piece of S restricts to one of T (resP); its path maps are those of S read on T (pathTot_resP), so restriction preserves respecting the cover (respectsCover_resP).
